The following events took place in '''3644 BBY'''.

==Events==
*[[Krikthasi Massacre]]<ref name="Time">Agent [[Protarius]] indicates during the quest "Target of Opportunity" on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that the Krikthasi Massacre took place two years earlier. Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/2|here]], the beginning of Act II of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that is concurrent to "Target of Opportunity" is set in [[3642 BBY]].</ref>
*The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Prudy]] met [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and the two became engaged, though Kimble broke off their engagement just before their wedding.<ref name="Best">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|The Best Intentions}}</ref>
*[[Andronikos Revel]] is released from Imperial prison.
